comments.author: Nicholas
comments.body_html:
You basically have to add those strings :

“Damage”: x,

“PenetrationPower”: x

on the ammo part and transform the default pen value from scale 6 to scale 10 , you can ask ChatGPT to transform the value for you if u want , imma give u an example here :

39 ( scale 6 ) —> 65 ( scale 10 )
48 —> 80
scale 6 is the maximum armor level in vanilla tarkov
scale 10 is maximum armor level in realism

That’s the logic i’m going to use to fix this ( That’s something i assumed , i think it’s a logical solution , although , i’m unexperienced on this so don’t relay 100% on my advice )

EDIT : I just noticed that u asked for damage , not pen , mb , anyway , for the damage , I used the same value it was reported in the vanilla mod , I’ve added the damage string just to be sure but it will work anyway even without “forcing” it with the added string , it will keep the vanilla damage that the mod author decided the ammo to have

comments.author: Nicholas

Hey Epic, a quick update regarding what we were talking about the other day. I discovered that the “SV98” is actually the master category for all bolt-action rifles. So, even though I say “SV98,” it’s actually just an ID that encompasses all other bolt-action weapons.

I’ll update the post from the last update to clear up this misunderstanding.

If you’d like, to make things clearer, you can check the list of master categories in Realism yourself;

Here’s the file path: D:\Games\SPT 3.9.5\user\mods\SPT-Realism\db\items\mastering.json

Thanks again to basherboy for the advice and clarification.
